floater.name: wolf_tunnels
floater.title: Tunnels
floater.floater.string: Click points on the ground from one mouth to the other. Double-click or press Finish (Enter) on the last one. Backspace or Undo point takes the last one back; Esc stops drawing.
Click on the tunnel's route to put a cavern there (its size: the Cavern size slider). Esc stops.
This region cannot make tunnels walkable yet (it needs the WolfSim tunnels update). Ask the region owner.
You can see this region's tunnels; only the region owner, the estate owner and estate managers can make them.
floater.text: Draw a tunnel under the ground. It is built as rock you can walk through, with caverns along the way, and the ground opens at its mouths.

scroll_list.name: tun_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's tunnels. Pick one to change it, delete it or go inside.

button.label: Change
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Change the tunnel picked in the list, then build it again

button.label: Go inside
button.name: go_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the floor just inside the picked tunnel's first mouth

button.label: Delete
button.name: delete_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the picked tunnel away: its rock, its walkable boxes and its record (asks first)

line_editor.name: tun_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The tunnel's name (also the rock object's name)

floater.text: Click points on the ground from one mouth to the other: start where people walk in, end where they come out.

button.label: Draw route
button.name: draw_route_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to click the route's points on the ground (press again to stop)

button.label: Undo point
button.name: undo_point_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the last point of the route back (Backspace)

button.label: Finish
button.name: finish_btn
button.tool_tip: The last point is the far mouth (or double-click it, or press Enter)

combo_box.name: tun_kind
combo_box.tool_tip: The tunnel's size. Walking: 4 m wide, 3.5 m high. Wide: 6 x 4.5 m. Rail: 6 x 6 m, for trains. Custom: your own.

radio_item.label: Smooth - engineered: straight walls, level floor, arched roof (railways, roads)
radio_item.name: smooth

radio_item.label: Rough - natural cave: uneven rock, changing width, bumpy roof (for exploring)
radio_item.name: rough

spinner.label: Floor at start
spinner.name: tun_z0
spinner.tool_tip: Height of the floor at the first mouth, metres (it starts at the ground there)

spinner.label: at end
spinner.name: tun_z1
spinner.tool_tip: Height of the floor at the far mouth, metres

button.label: To the ground
button.name: ground_btn
button.tool_tip: Put both mouths' floors back on the ground where they are

text.name: grade_info
text.tool_tip: The floor runs in one smooth grade from mouth to mouth

button.label: Add cavern
button.name: cavern_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to click caverns onto the route (press again to stop)

slider.label: Cavern size
slider.name: cavern_r
slider.tool_tip: Radius of the next cavern, metres (3 to 30)

check_box.label: Stone arches at the mouths
check_box.name: tun_portals
check_box.tool_tip: A stone portal round each mouth

button.label: Build
button.name: build_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the tunnel, make its rock, rez it and make it walkable (an old build of it is taken away first)

button.label: Stop editing
button.name: cancel_edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the drawing away without building it

check_box.label: Advanced: the region's walkable boxes
check_box.name: advanced_check
check_box.tool_tip: Every walkable box in this region, with its numbers

scroll_list.name: box_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's walkable boxes. Pick one to see its numbers and change them.

button.label: Refresh
button.name: refresh_btn
button.tool_tip: Read this region's tunnels and boxes again

check_box.label: Show the boxes in the world
check_box.name: show_outlines
check_box.tool_tip: Outlines of the walkable boxes, drawn through the ground, while this window is open

button.label: Delete box
button.name: delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the picked box from the region (asks first)

button.label: Go inside
button.name: go_btn
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the floor of the picked box

button.label: Save changes
button.name: save_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the picked box's new numbers to the region
